test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

A major ________ of modern times is that we have come to assume that all creation is ________ to the material interests of us, the homo-sapiens inhabiting earth, which has cut the _________ relationship we otherwise enjoyed with other constituents of creation
solution:
The correct answer is "**fallacy, subservient, symbiotic**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fallacy **means **untrue notions**.

 
 
• **Example**: *The belief that the corner house is haunted is a** fallacy.** *
 
 
 
• **Subservient** means **acting as subordinate**.
 
 
• **Example:** *Even though Willy is talented, he acts as a ****subservient*.** 
 
 
 
• **Symbiotic** means **dependence on each other equally**. 
 
 
• **Example:** *Tina and her friend share a **symbiotic** relationship. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, the appropriate answer is "fallacy, subservient, symbiotic". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Frankness** - being honest and open.
 
• **Superior** - in a higher rank or position.
 
• **Disadvantageous **- without any benefit. 
 
• **Accuracy** - exactly to the point. 
 
• **Domineering** - wanting to control other people with a strong character.
 
• **Encumbering** - a burden.
 
• **Felicity** - state of being very happy.
 
• **Disobedient** - refusal to listen to the rules.
 
• **Hindering** - troubling.
